description:
Create a chatbot

Creates a chatbot and provisions it in the voice engine in the same request, then derives its hosted chat page URL from the new identifier. Only `name` is required; the language defaults to `de` and the widget appearance fields all have platform defaults. The widget microphone stays off until `enableVoice` is true; a spoken conversation then runs on the voice allowance of the account, and `voiceId` chooses the voice from GET /voices or GET /voices/available. Unset text fields are stored with sensible fallbacks, so an omitted `greeting` becomes a generic opening line and an omitted display name repeats `name`. The response carries the new identifier and the public URL, not the full chatbot.

body.description: The chatbot configuration, covering behaviour, widget appearance and retention. `allowedDomains` restricts which sites may embed the widget; leave it out to allow any.

allowedDomains.description: Hostnames allowed to embed this widget (Referer-checked, fail-closed). Empty/omitted = unrestricted.

chatbotDisplayName.description: The name shown to end-users in the chat widget header.

clientEvents.description: Real-time event configuration for SDK/Frontend integration.

audio.description: Enable audio events for voice-capable widgets.

user_transcript.description: Stream user transcripts back to the client.

enableVoice.description: Lets visitors talk to the chatbot through the widget microphone. A spoken conversation runs on the voice allowance of the account. Defaults to false.

greeting.description: The first message a user sees when opening the chat widget.

language.description: Primary language for the chatbot (ISO 639-1). Affects NLP and default greetings.

llmModel.description: The LLM brain powering the chat. Options: EchoCall-Smart, EchoCall-Voice.

logoUrl.description: URL to a custom logo image for the chat widget.

name.description: Internal name of the chatbot for identification in the dashboard.

primaryColor.description: The main brand color (Hex) used for the chat bubble and header.

retentionDays.description: Auto-deletion period for chat logs in days. Defaults to 30. -1 for infinity.

saveConversations.description: Whether to store chat history in the EchoCall database.

supportedLanguages.description: All languages the chatbot can converse in, as ISO-639-1 codes. First element = primary language.

systemPrompt.description: Base instructions defining the chatbot's personality and scope of knowledge.

teaserMessage.description: Marketing hook shown in the proactive teaser bubble before the visitor opens the chat. Independent from `greeting`. Empty = no teaser bubble.

textOnlyMode.description: Deprecated: the inverse of `enableVoice`, kept for clients written against 1.12. `false` switches the voice on. Ignored when `enableVoice` is present.

voiceId.description: The voice the chatbot speaks with, from GET /voices or GET /voices/available. Omit for the engine default voice. Only used while `enableVoice` is true.

widgetLanguage.description: Overrides the widget UI chrome language (buttons, placeholders, aria-labels), independent of the conversation `language`. Empty/omitted = automatic, follows `language`.

widgetPosition.description: Where the chat bubble appears on the user's screen.

widgetSize.description: The relative size of the chat window.

widgetStyle.description: The visual variant of the chat interface.

zeroPiiRetention.description: Strict privacy mode. Stored data will be anonymized.
